_provenance: rex's own translations, written from the English for rex on 2026-10-25 without reference to Plex's. Only the set of (string, language) pairs and the strings PMS leaves in English follow the measurement described here: Cycle 65. The activity titles and subtitles a real PMS pushes on the notification sockets and answers on /activities, per X-Plex-Language, read out of the 1.42.2 reference's own gettext catalogues (Resources/locale/*/LC_MESSAGES/plex.mo) for the message ids rex emits; {1} is the inserted name or count. The language-to-catalogue map (ca reads es, nb reads no, cs/et/hr/ja/zh their regional files) was fitted to plexscratch42's live frames in 12 languages, which the table reproduces exactly. A message id the catalogue lacks (Analyzing Media, Updating Metadata) stays English on a real PMS too. Cycle 66: `progress` holds the butler's sentences, which follow the socket's language the same way (plexscratch42, ten languages), and af, no and pt-BR read their own catalogues.
